spans.s: भोग m. 1. Eating; 2. use, enjoyment, तदुपस्थितमग्रहीदजः पितुराज्ञेति न भोगतृष्णया R.viii.2, Megh.ii.49; 3. advantage, utility; 4. sexual enjoyment; 5. the use of a deposit; 6. rule, government; 7. experiencing, suffering; 8. food; 9. a repast, a banquet; 10. food offered to an idol; 11. any object of enjoyment, Bg.i.32, ii.5; 12. gain, profit, income; 13. wealth; 14. pleasure, luxury; 15. the wages of prostitution; 16. a curve, a coil; 17. the expanded hood of a snake; 18. the body of a serpent, भोगिभोगासमासीनं ददृशुस्तं दिवौकसः R.x.7, xi.59; 19. a snake.
भोग-अर्ह (I) a. fit for enjoyment.
भोग-अर्ह (II) n. wealth, property.
भोग-अर्ह्य n. corn.
भोग-आधि m. a pledge that may be used until it is redeemed.
भोग-आवली f. the panegyric of a bard.
भोग-आवास m. the women’s apartments.
भोग-कर a. affording enjoyment.
भोग-गुच्छ n. wages of prostitution.
भोग-गृह n. the private apartments.
भोग-तृष्णा f. thirst for worldly enjoyment.
भोग-देह m. the body which a dead person carries with him.
भोग-धर m. a snake.
भोग-पति m. the governer of a town or province.
भोग-पाल m. a groom.
भोग-पिशाचिका f. hunger.
भोग-भृतक m. a servant who works for mere maintenance.
भोग-वत् (I) a. 1. affording pleasure, delightful; 2. happy, prosperous; 3. having curves.
भोग-वत् (II) m. 1. a snake; 2. a mountain; 3. dancing, acting and singing together.
भोग-वती f. 1. the night of the second day of a lunar month; 2. an epithet of the Ganges of the lower world; 3. an epithet of the city of snakes in the lower regions.
भोग-वस्तु n. an object of enjoyment.
भोग-सद्मन् n. the women’s apartments.
भोग-स्थान n. 1. the women’s apartments; 2. the body as the seat of all enjoyment.
भोगिक m. A groom.
भोगिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Eating; 2. enjoying, Bg.xvi.14; 3. possessing; 4. suffering, experiencing; 5. having curves; 6. rich, opulent.
भोगिन् (II) m. 1. A snake, भोगिभोगासनासीनम् R.x.7, ii.32, iv.48, K.S.v.78, Rt.i.16; 2. a king; 3. a barber; 4. the headman of a village; 5. the constellation Āśleshā.
भोगिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Eating; 2. enjoying, Bg.xvi.14; 3. possessing; 4. suffering, experiencing; 5. having curves; 6. rich, opulent.
भोगिनी f. Any woman of the royal harem except the crowned queen.
भोगिन्-इंद्र, -ईश m. 1. an epithet of Śeṣa; 2. of Vāsuki.
भोगिन्-इंद्र, -ईश m. 1. an epithet of Śeṣa; 2. of Vāsuki.
भोगिन्-कांत m. air, wind.
भोगिन्-भुज् m. 1. a peacock; 2. an ichneumon.
भोगिन्-वल्लभ n. sandal.
भोग्य (I) a. (f. ग्या) 1. To be enjoyed, R.viii.14; 2. to be experienced; 3. profitable.
भोग्य (II) n. 1. Wealth, property; 2. grain, corn.
भोग्य (III) m. A pledge that can be used until redeemed.
भोग्य (I) a. (f. ग्या) 1. To be enjoyed, R.viii.14; 2. to be experienced; 3. profitable.
भोग्या f. A harlot, a prostitute.
